listing.name: Mushihimesama Futari Ver 1.5 — futari_realcomp (springah)
listing.summary: Upstream explicitly describes this as an unfinished development project. Its beta reportedly runs attract mode, menus, Normal Play, Training, saves and native audio, with known defects. Startup on an M3 Max Mac does not establish a complete campaign. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 Mushihimesama Futari Ver 1.5 files, including the title, shell and two game modules. The exact region, revision and module hashes are not confirmed here; check upstream’s configurations and status before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: On Windows, follow build_win.sh or build_win_dll.sh with Git Bash, clang and lld. The matching workbench also needs XDK 9328. Linux build_linux.sh and macOS build_mac.sh are development builds requiring external dependencies and the decompilation tree. No ready-to-use game package is confirmed.

warnings: Upstream explicitly describes this as an unfinished development project. Its beta reportedly runs attract mode, menus, Normal Play, Training, saves and native audio, with known defects. Startup on an M3 Max Mac does not establish a complete campaign.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
